Score

CRAP = cx² × (1 − cov)³ + cx. Complexity that tests never reach grows the score fast; a fully covered function scores exactly its complexity.

Threshold

Pass when CRAP ≤ 6; fail when CRAP > 6. The common industry limit is 30; this project uses 6.

Inputs

Region coverage from llvm-cov export; cyclomatic complexity from lexed Swift tokens over each function's exact source range, nested closures scored separately. 882 implicit closures are counted in their parents.
